description: This file defines the SecurityPolicy class within the Twig sandbox extension, implementing a security model that enforces allowed tags, filters, methods, properties, and functions for safe template execution in sandbox mode.

classes.name: SecurityPolicy
classes.description: Implements a security policy for Twig's sandbox mode, controlling access to tags, filters, methods, properties, and functions, and providing security checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the security policy with allowed tags, filters, methods, properties, and functions.

methods.name: setAllowedTags
methods.description: Sets the list of allowed tags.

methods.name: setAllowedFilters
methods.description: Sets the list of allowed filters.

methods.name: setAllowedMethods
methods.description: Sets the list of allowed methods per class.

methods.name: setAllowedProperties
methods.description: Sets the list of allowed properties.

methods.name: setAllowedFunctions
methods.description: Sets the list of allowed functions.

methods.name: checkSecurity
methods.description: Checks whether the provided tags, filters, and functions are allowed; throws exceptions if not.

methods.name: checkMethodAllowed
methods.description: Verifies if calling a method on an object is permitted.

methods.name: checkPropertyAllowed
methods.description: Verifies if accessing a property on an object is permitted.
